sentence: Market penalties for AI service failures have grown harsher in recent years [CITE], and the negative reaction to AI-heavy service patents shows only in the two most recent decades
passage: [Patel (2026), p. 1] "Decade-wise analysis reveals effects are significant only in the 2010s and 2020s, suggesting evolving market perceptions of AI-driven servitization."

gemini.note: The passage supports the timing of the effects to the two most recent decades, but it does not specify that these effects were a negative reaction, nor does it mention patents.
